structures.name: Göbekli Tepe
structures.blurb: Stone circles raised before cities. A ritual skyline older than farming.

structures.name: Stonehenge
structures.blurb: Sarsen and bluestone arranged for light, death, and the year's turning.

structures.name: Great Pyramid of Giza
structures.blurb: Four faces of limestone once white enough to blind. Still the purest mass on the plateau.

structures.name: Parthenon
structures.blurb: Optical corrections in marble. A temple that pretends to be perfectly straight.

structures.name: Pantheon
structures.blurb: An oculus open to weather. Concrete dome still teaching engineers humility.

structures.name: Hagia Sophia
structures.blurb: A dome that seemed to hang from heaven. Empire after empire kept the light.

structures.name: Angkor Wat
structures.blurb: A mountain of galleries carved for gods and kings, ringed by a man-made sea.

structures.name: Chartres Cathedral
structures.blurb: Blue glass that still stops breath. Vertical prayer in limestone.

structures.name: Machu Picchu
structures.blurb: Stone fitted without mortar on a green knife-edge of the Andes.

structures.name: Taj Mahal
structures.blurb: White marble grief made perfect. A love letter that became a skyline.

structures.name: Sagrada Família
structures.blurb: Still rising. Stone grown like forest under Gaudí's unfinished dream.

structures.name: Eiffel Tower
structures.blurb: Iron lace against the sky. Temporary pride that refused to leave.

structures.name: Fallingwater
structures.blurb: A house that listens to water. Cantilevers over a stream as if nature invited it.

structures.name: Sydney Opera House
structures.blurb: Shells of ceramic white. Geometry sailing into the harbor light.

structures.name: Burj Khalifa
structures.blurb: A needle of glass and steel. Ambition measured in meters of sky.

structures.name: Grand Canyon
structures.blurb: A river writing geology in open air. Layers of time you can stand inside.

structures.name: Uluru
structures.blurb: A single sandstone heart in the red center. Sacred mass under changing light.

structures.name: Hạ Long Bay
structures.blurb: Limestone towers rising from green water. A drowned karst dream.

structures.name: Zhangjiajie Pillars
structures.blurb: Quartz-sandstone columns like a forest of stone. Fog makes them float.

structures.name: Aurora Borealis Skies
structures.blurb: Not stone, but architecture of light. Solar wind painting the night vault.

structures.name: Great Barrier Reef
structures.blurb: Living architecture of coral. A city built by polyps over half a million years.

structures.name: Mount Fuji
structures.blurb: A near-perfect cone of fire and snow. Icon before any human skyline.

structures.name: Socotra Dragon's Blood Forest
structures.blurb: Umbrella trees on an island time forgot. Botany as architecture.

structures.name: Petra
structures.blurb: Facades cut into rose rock. A city half carved, half hidden by the desert.

structures.name: Great Wall of China
structures.blurb: A dragon of earth and brick on the ridges. Defense as landscape.

structures.name: Colosseum
structures.blurb: An ellipse of arches for spectacle. Rome's most enduring stage set.

structures.name: Borobudur
structures.blurb: A stone mandala of ascending terraces. Pilgrimage written as plan.

structures.name: Neuschwanstein
structures.blurb: A fairy-tale silhouette on a ridge. Romanticism poured into towers.

structures.name: Guggenheim Bilbao
structures.blurb: Titanium curves catching river light. A building that remade a city.

structures.name: Salk Institute
structures.blurb: Concrete, teak, and a channel of water aimed at the Pacific horizon.
